task:
A fund holds 3857 credits. Its first grant is 16% of that original balance. Return 41% of this grant to the fund, so that portion is not spent. A second grant is 9% of the original balance minus 9 credits (the 9 credits are subtracted BEFORE taking the percentage). What is total spending after the returned portion? Give an exact answer. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 6 credits, then discount the whole amount by 9%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 12% surcharge, then subtract 9 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 8 credits, then discount the whole amount by 5%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 7% surcharge, then subtract 11 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 11 credits, then discount the whole amount by 5%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 11% surcharge, then subtract 27 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 11 credits, then discount the whole amount by 12%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 5% surcharge, then subtract 20 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 19 credits, then discount the whole amount by 17%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 7% surcharge, then subtract 19 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 5 credits, then discount the whole amount by 3%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 14% surcharge, then subtract 8 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 17 credits, then discount the whole amount by 3%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 15% surcharge, then subtract 6 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 8 credits, then discount the whole amount by 11%.
Adjustment 16: apply a 10% surcharge, then subtract 26 credits.
Adjustment 17: add 18 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Adjustment 18: apply a 19% surcharge, then subtract 27 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 24 credits, then discount the whole amount by 15%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
